name: erp_sales_order_create
description: Create a sales order for a customer; new orders start in pendingApproval (POST /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder)

entity.description: Customer (entity) internal id the order is billed to, e.g. customer_002.

entity_name.description: Display name of the customer account, e.g. 'Summit Group Account'.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

total.description: Order total in the transaction currency (total).
